capabilities: Export the open note as a cheatsheet PDF
Recommend orientation, columns and font size that fit the paper
Warn about content that overflows or is cut off
Remove theme margins and padding for compact spacing
Print in greyscale or with the theme background
disambiguation: Not a hotkey or command reference generator; it lays out the current note as a printable PDF.
extras: Desktop only, because PDF export uses Electron; tested on Windows. No network requests, accounts or telemetry. The PDF is written wherever the save dialog points, which can be outside the vault.
motivation: Built for college and university students who want a printable exam cheatsheet from their notes.
problem: Long, loosely formatted notes do not print as a compact reference sheet that fits on one exam page.
summary: Exports the open note as a dense cheatsheet PDF on one A4 or US Letter sheet, keeping theme, LaTeX, images and tables.
